title: Asymptotically Self-Similar Blowup for 3D Incompressible Euler with $C^{1, 1/3-}$ Velocity II: 3D Profiles, Blowup, and Limiting behavior
summary: For any $α\in (0,1/3)$, we construct exact $C^α$ self-similar blowup profiles for the vorticity of the 3D incompressible Euler equation without swirl, and build on them to prove asymptotically self-similar blowup from $C_c^α$ initial vorticity and $C^{1,α}\cap L^2$ initial velocity. Moreover, we provide a complete characterization of the limiting behavior of the $C^α$ vorticity profiles and the associated blowup solutions as $α\to(1/3)^-$.
